purpose: Fluid zoom through the native path (y2s43): Nord2Metal only (redwooddrawable.m); libredwoodair.dylib stays the installed y2s42 one. Run q10hw: while the zoom moves, CMCapture's 'Preview Scaler' has VideoToolbox cut and enlarge what each picture lacks of the zoom wanted (FinalCropRect), VideoToolbox writes its '420f' destination through R32Uint (53) textures over each plane -- several of the plane's bytes in one texel, the texture a quarter (half) of the plane's width -- and this driver refused them ('plane 0 holds 1 byte a texel and Metal format 53 holds 4', 2048 times), so every such picture was dropped (-12914, PixelTransferFailure) and the viewfinder moved only when the zoom stopped. Now a plain format whose texel is a whole number of the plane's elements is imported in place at the plane's width divided accordingly (VideoToolbox's own division), on a plane of '420f'/'420v' and on a plain single-plane surface. Previous file kept as /private/var/db/nord2-metal/Nord2Metal.pre-vt3; receipt.json inventory updated. Undo: guest-vt3-undo.sh.
